package: @astryxdesign/core

# DropdownMenuRadioItem

A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio"). Must be used inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

## Import

```tsx
import { DropdownMenuRadioItem } from '@astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | - | The value this item represents within its group. The group's value matches against this to determine the checked state. **(required)** |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Primary label text identifying the option. **(required)** |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Secondary description text displayed below the label. |
| `icon` | `IconType` | - | Icon to display before the label. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether this individual radio item is disabled. A disabled item stays in the accessibility tree as disabled (aria-disabled), and the arrow keys and typeahead reach it so keyboard users find it. The pointer highlight skips it, and selection is blocked. |
| `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to render after the label and description, such as a badge or metadata. |
| `ref` | `React.Ref<HTMLElement>` | - | Ref forwarded to the row root, the element carrying role="menuitemradio". Register the row with an element-keyed observer or overlay. |
